//: When the documented check cannot start, the report says what is unverified instead of calling the work checked. Checked on the reply, so it is approximate.
title: A check that could not start is reported, not counted

checks.pattern: (?i)unverified|not verified|could(n't| not) (run|verify|start)|did(n't| not) (run|start)|unable to run|failed to start|not found|not installed|isn't installed|suitekit
